note: A product is allowed only when its own standard clears on the conservative side of the 90% interval. Structural concrete is never marked allowed.

classes.label: Paver
classes.clause: IS 15658: compressive strength at least 30 MPa and water absorption not more than 6% by mass.

classes.label: Hollow concrete block
classes.clause: IS 2185 Part 1 hollow masonry: compressive strength at least 3.5 MPa on the lower confidence bound.

classes.label: Solid concrete block
classes.clause: IS 2185 Part 1 solid masonry: compressive strength at least 5.0 MPa on the lower confidence bound.

classes.label: Structural concrete
classes.clause: IS 456 M20. A lower bound that clears the grade still means screen for a lab trial. This is not a certificate.
